statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is LOW while macro Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ remains inside the overnight range and away from either extreme; oil above $91 and a U.S. 10-year yield near 4.78% keep macro Stress extreme.
headline: Two-sided overnight NQ structure lowers Tail while oil and yields keep Stress extreme
body: Delayed NQ is 29,492.50, down 0.07% from the prior close, after trading within the overnight range. Price has rebounded from the overnight low and is not holding an extreme. Brent above $91, a 10-year Treasury yield near 4.78% and renewed U.S.-Iran tension keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 20% to 26%. The only elevated slot was 08:00 UTC on August 31; all later historical slots were WATCH. Stress stayed extreme at 97-99%, while the dominant mode shifted from event/whipsaw to mixed at 21:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is LOW at 19% because delayed NQ is inside the overnight range with evidence of retracement. Conditional Tail returns to WATCH from the Europe handoff and peaks at 24% around Barr, the cash open and the 14:00 UTC data cluster; higher bands still require persistent one-way structure.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is 29,492.50, only 0.07% below the prior close and inside the overnight range; the rebound from the low leaves price away from either extreme. Brent above $91 and the 10-year yield near 4.78% keep Stress extreme.
drivers: NQ remains inside the overnight range

forecast.analysis: If late-Asia trade continues to overlap the overnight range and pullbacks remain two-sided, Tail would stay LOW; a fresh directional break with weak retracement would move it back to WATCH.
The Europe handoff raises conditional Tail to WATCH because acceptance outside the overnight range could improve directional efficiency; rejection back into the range would contain it.

European-opening flow would matter most through pullback depth: shallow retracements plus repeated extension would raise concern, while rotation across the overnight range would preserve mixed structure.
If Europe extends without meaningful retracement, Tail would remain WATCH; failed follow-through and range re-entry would favor two-sided structure despite elevated macro Stress.
By mid-Europe, sustained directional efficiency would be required to keep Tail elevated; repeated range overlap would argue against a pathological price path.
Absent a persistent European trend, elevated oil and yields would remain Stress amplifiers rather than direct Tail evidence; holding near session extremes would be the key contrary signal.
As U.S. participation increases, repeated extension after a failed retracement would be the main Tail amplifier; orderly pullbacks would keep the regime mixed.
Pre-open positioning could raise Tail if a directional impulse persists into U.S. liquidity; compression or a meaningful retracement would cap it below a block threshold.
Barr's 13:05 UTC remarks and the 13:30 UTC cash open form a concentrated checkpoint. Tail would approach the top of WATCH only if opening flow becomes one-way with shallow pullbacks.

JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending arrive at 14:00 UTC. The event cluster raises Stress sharply; Tail would remain WATCH unless post-release price discovery becomes persistently one-way.
The first post-data hour carries delayed-second-leg risk. Repeated extension after failed retracements would sustain high-end WATCH; orderly reversal or volatility decay would reduce Tail quickly.
If the data impulse has produced clear retracements by this hour, Tail would recede; continued extreme holding with aligned rates and technology breadth would keep concern elevated.
U.S. midday liquidity would usually favor more rotation; Tail would remain WATCH only if directional efficiency persists through the quieter period.
Into the afternoon, a stable cross-asset backdrop and two-sided NQ trade would contain Tail; renewed oil or yield acceleration with index extension would raise it.
Approaching power hour, late institutional flow can re-accelerate a trend; strong retracements or range overlap would keep Tail near the low end of WATCH.
The cash-close window would matter through persistence rather than move size: repeated extension into the close would keep Tail elevated, while reversal would contain it.
After the cash close, thinner conditions can exaggerate moves. Without confirmed one-way structure, Tail would ease while macro Stress remains elevated.
At the Globex reopen, a large gap with immediate continuation would be a new Tail signal; a balanced reopen around settlement would keep WATCH contained.
If early Globex trade remains balanced, Tail would return to LOW; a fresh geopolitical discontinuity could reprice Stress rapidly before price-path evidence confirms Tail.
Overnight Tail would stay LOW if Asia begins with overlapping ranges and normal retracements; a sustained break with shallow pullbacks would invalidate that baseline.
A quiet Asian session with repeated mean reversion would keep Tail LOW even if yields and oil stay elevated; synchronized cross-asset acceleration would raise risk.
If price remains away from session extremes and retracements continue, Tail would stay LOW; persistent extreme holding would be the main escalation checkpoint.
Late-Asia structure would remain low-Tail under balanced trade; a clean range break with repeated extension would move the next assessment back toward WATCH.
